summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall script downloads a tgz over HTTPS from a hardcoded bare IPv4 endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/<version>) with certificate validation disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false) and no hash or signature verification. The archive is extracted, the extracted binary is chmod 0755 and hardlinked into bin/.onecode, becoming the code executed whenever the onecode CLI is invoked. The 301/302 redirect handler recursively re-invokes the same downloader with rejectUnauthorized:false, so the endpoint (or any on-path attacker, given the disabled TLS validation) can redirect the fetch to arbitrary infrastructure while the response is still written to disk and executed. The fetch source is a non-DNS bare IP unrelated to the npm publisher, and no publisher-side integrity verification is performed on the retrieved binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
